content:
The execution failed because the summary markdown file (`/root/reagent_policy_summary.md`) included comma separators in currency values (e.g., `$-7,106.39`), which caused the validation test to fail. The test expected plain numbers (e.g., `$-7106.39`). 

Error trace from `test_outputs.py`:
`AssertionError: assert '-7,106.39' in '# Reagent Policy Summary\nTotal small-kit margin USD: $-7106.39\n...'`

Ensure that when writing the markdown summary, you format floats without commas: use `f'${value:.2f}'` instead of `f'${value:,.2f}'`.
reasoning: The failure is directly tied to a specific formatting requirement (no commas in markdown) explicitly mentioned in the instructions but missed in the implementation. A trace-level report is most effective here to point out the exact string mismatch.
